name: The Zenith Crown
core_rationale: Highest apogee ring of Continent 03 where crystallized star-anchors and inverted aurora bridges crown the Shattered Halo above Nebula Undertide.
local_conflict: Celestial aurora-wyrms and silent star-wardens guard the upper airship beacon that links back to Hearthbloom Sky-Spire.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider-scouts who rode a Star-Tide updraft above Undertide Sanctuary swear they saw a ring of white-gold anchor towers floating inside the aurora.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A crown of white-gold star-anchors and shimmering aurora bridges high above the violet whirlpool.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Who holds the master ignition key to the Hearthbloom Sky-Spire airship beacon atop the Zenith Crown?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater at the upper apogee of Continent 03 The Shattered Halo.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A floating crown of white-gold star-anchors and aurora bridges suspended above the inverted ocean whirlpool.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 13.0m aurora-glass walkways, 0.60m beacon ignition consoles, and 0.14m star-stone risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: awaiting playable leaf map authoring for Aurora Tether and Crown Beacon Citadel.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Includes complete mystery_hook and reserves hunting-area-aurora-tether as a Mystery frontier.
